name: PT Humpuss Maritim Internasional Tbk
summary: PT Humpuss Maritim Internasional Tbk., together with its subsidiaries, transports liquified natural gas, crude oil, fuel oil, chemicals, containers, coal, and other sea cargoes in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Vessel Chartering Services, and Crew Management, Ship Management, and Other Services. The company offers LNG transportation, oil and petrochemical transportation, marine support, offshore support vessel, ship management, and crewing management and crew training center services. It also engages in air/water transportation; consultation management; and trading. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
